name: @dsh-toolset/md-map
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 进程内集成插件：Markdown 项目级结构与引用分析（锚点、文档间链接、wiki 链接、影响面、断链）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-md-map && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-md-map && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-md-map node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-md-map tmp/cov-md-map/report.json
